# Aarti Sangrah ki Duniya

> The complete world of Hindu aartis — Hindi lyrics with English transliteration, translation, and audio for every major deity.

Aarti Sangrah ki Duniya (आरती संग्रह की दुनिया) is a trilingual Hindu devotional PWA. Every aarti is presented in Hindi Devanagari, English transliteration, and English translation, with synced audio, karaoke mode, favorites, reminders, and offline support. Built by Aayush Sharma.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse all deities and the daily aarti.
- [Favorites](/favorites): Your saved aartis stored locally.
- [About the Developer](/about-developer): About Aayush Sharma, the creator.

## Deities

- [Ganesh](/deity/ganesh): Ganesh aartis including Jai Ganesh Deva.
- [Shiv](/deity/shiv): Shiv aartis including Om Jai Shiv Omkara.
- [Vishnu](/deity/vishnu): Vishnu aartis including Om Jai Jagdish Hare.
- [Lakshmi](/deity/lakshmi): Lakshmi aartis including Om Jai Lakshmi Mata.
- [Hanuman](/deity/hanuman): Hanuman aartis and Chalisa.
- [Durga](/deity/durga): Durga aartis including Jai Ambe Gauri.
- [Krishna](/deity/krishna): Krishna aartis and bhajans.
- [Ram](/deity/ram): Ram aartis including Shri Ram Aarti.
- [Sai Baba](/deity/sai): Sai Baba aartis.
- [Surya](/deity/surya): Surya Dev aartis.
- [Shani](/deity/shani): Shani Dev aartis.
- [Saraswati](/deity/saraswati): Saraswati aartis.
